decisions: Direct generic parameter types use canonical primary/secondary/tertiary semantic roles.
A composite generic primary input retains no bound input type and its source type template.
A composite generic user return or additional parameter retains Unit plus its template, matching CSharp declaration binding.
Constraint parsing retains actual associated-type AST; stable type identity is resolved from that annotation, not copied from its display text.
Value generics, specialized instances, inferred/local/block/native function bindings remain pending; no production cache integration claim.
